body.markdown:
> Draft prepared with Kalos from campaign records on 2026-11-20. Not reviewed. Not an approved procedure.

# Run recipe draft

## Purpose

This draft describes how to prepare each run listed below and record `titer_g_L` for it, using the settings held in the campaign record.
It is a starting point for the lab's own procedure, not a procedure in itself.

## Scope

Covers the recipes in the settings table, each identified by its record reference.
Safety: [[TO FILL: safety_notes]]
Hazards: [[TO FILL: hazard_flags]]

## Materials

| Input | Quantity | Lot | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| pH | [[TO FILL: material_quantities]] | [[TO FILL: material_lot_numbers]] | |
| temperature_C | [[TO FILL: material_quantities]] | [[TO FILL: material_lot_numbers]] | |
| glucose_gL | [[TO FILL: material_quantities]] | [[TO FILL: material_lot_numbers]] | |
| [[TO FILL: other_materials]] | | | |

## Equipment

- [[TO FILL: equipment_list]]
- Equipment ids: [[TO FILL: equipment_ids]]

## Settings

Record references:

- Recipe A: `proposal:2.0`

| Recipe | Parameter | Value | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | pH | 7.019 | Setting |
| A | temperature_C | 37.279 | Setting |
| A | glucose_gL | 10.898 | Setting |
| A | titer_g_L | 0.685 | Predicted |
| A | titer_g_L | 0.059 | Predicted spread |
| all | pH | 6.036 | Search range, low |
| all | pH | 7.519 | Search range, high |
| all | temperature_C | 30.039 | Search range, low |
| all | temperature_C | 38.74 | Search range, high |
| all | glucose_gL | 2.133 | Search range, low |
| all | glucose_gL | 10.898 | Search range, high |

Predicted values are the model's estimate at the time of the analysis, not a measurement.

## Procedure

1. Check that every material and piece of equipment listed above is at hand, and write the lot numbers into the materials table.
2. Prepare one run per recipe. Set each input to its setting: Recipe A: pH 7.019; temperature_C 37.279; glucose_gL 10.898.
3. Record the value reached for each setting before going on.
4. Carry out the run as described in [[TO FILL: run_method]].
5. Measure `titer_g_L` as described in [[TO FILL: measurement_method]] and record it in the settings table as Measured.

## In-process checks

- [[TO FILL: in_process_checks]]
- Record the value reached for each setting next to it in the settings table.

## Acceptance criteria

- [[TO FILL: acceptance_limits]]

## Deviations and notes

- [[TO FILL: deviation_handling]]
- Note anything that departed from the written steps, with the step number.
